name: Bọt Biển City #8 - Dual-Phase Custom Pass
description:
An interactive dual-tier slot in the Bọt Biển City collection.

[Collector Utility]: Purchasing this custom slot grants you the privilege to submit a reference portrait. Your character will be:
1. Illustrated into this Phase 1 canvas as an exclusive digital figure.
2. Permanently integrated into the grand Phase 2 Architectural Masterpiece (#6), carefully positioned by the architect to harmonize with the physical structure.

[Submission Terms & Guidelines]
- Civility: Submitted photos must be respectful. No nudity, sexually explicit, violent, defamatory, or hateful content.
- Non-Political: Strictly no political figures, party symbols, propaganda, or sensitive geopolitical themes.
- Artistic Discretion: The architect retains final creative authority regarding spatial perspective, scale, and character placement in Phase 2.
- Refund Policy: If a submission violates these rules, an alternative must be provided within 7 days. If unresolved, the buyer must transfer the NFT back to receive a refund (minus gas fees). Otherwise, the piece remains in its original form.

Submit your portrait via the external link below.
